Poweramp\'s shuffle is a cycle rather than a toggle (in order -> shuffle songs -> shuffle categories -> ...), so pressing it once moves your current mode to the next one. The default, \"leave it alone\", keeps whatever you set in Poweramp.

This page reopens itself after a change; press Apply at the bottom to update the bar.
Show the clock and battery in the bar
The clock sits at the top left as hours:minutes:seconds, the battery at the top right as a rectangular icon with a percentage.
Shuffle the whole tree (the app picks the order)

On by default. Poweramp\'s folder queue holds one folder and it does not take playlists from outside, so the app picks the order itself and hands over the next song about 1.5 seconds before each one ends. The cost is a gap of roughly 0.3 to 1 second between tracks, and occasionally a moment of the player\'s own next track. Turning it off restores the original behaviour.
